title: Approve composition
question: iOS System Glass is locked. Which composition should drive the rebuild? (Structure only — material language stays Liquid Glass.)

options.label: Lens Stack
options.thesis: Stacked clear glass workout cards under a sticky header; closest to today’s task flow.
options.viewport: Header → progress capsule → stacked exercise lenses → floating pill tabs.
options.risk: Can feel familiar if glass depth is underplayed.

options.label: Dock & Stage
options.thesis: One dominant active exercise on a glass stage; next moves live in a tray.
options.viewport: Large media stage → title/prescription → lime Done → thumbnail tray → thick dock.
options.risk: Changes workout browsing density; needs care with multi-exercise plans.

options.label: Index Glass
options.thesis: Continuous glass index strips — library-first scanability as the system grammar.
options.viewport: Filter bar → dense glass rows → floating nav.
options.risk: Workout cards may feel too compressed if applied wholesale.
